name: automattic/jetpackcrm
description: [Jetpack CRM](https://jetpackcrm.com) Core CRM Plugin - WordPress.org Hosted

scripts.cs: if ! files=$(git diff --diff-filter=d --name-only trunk HEAD -- '*.php'); then echo 'Could not diff against trunk.' >&2; exit 1; fi; if [ -z "$files" ]; then echo 'No PHP changes found.'; else php -d auto_prepend_file=tests/suppress_php84_deprecations.php vendor/bin/phpcs-changed -s --git --git-base trunk --phpcs-path scripts/phpcs.sh $files; fi
scripts.cs-staged: if ! files=$(git diff --diff-filter=d --name-only --cached -- '*.php'); then echo 'Could not read staged changes.' >&2; exit 1; fi; if [ -z "$files" ]; then echo 'No PHP changes found.'; else php -d auto_prepend_file=tests/suppress_php84_deprecations.php vendor/bin/phpcs-changed -s --git --git-staged --phpcs-path scripts/phpcs.sh $files; fi
scripts.cs-unstaged: if ! files=$(git diff --diff-filter=d --name-only -- '*.php'); then echo 'Could not read unstaged changes.' >&2; exit 1; fi; if [ -z "$files" ]; then echo 'No PHP changes found.'; else php -d auto_prepend_file=tests/suppress_php84_deprecations.php vendor/bin/phpcs-changed -s --git --git-unstaged --phpcs-path scripts/phpcs.sh $files; fi
